title: Foundation Model Fine-Tuning with Attention-based Multi-View Fusion for Multi-Task Cardiac Function Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.18816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In cardio-oncology, left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is the standard biomarker for monitoring cardiac function during cancer therapy. However, its estimation from echocardiography is highly operator dependent, and clinically meaningful declines are often detected only after myocardial injury has progressed, motivating automated methods for standardized assessment and earlier detection of LV dysfunction. To address this need, we propose a multi-task framework integrating cardiac cycle-based temporal standardization, multi-view spatiotemporal feature extraction, and joint optimization for LVEF estimation and LV dysfunction classification. Apical four- and two-chamber echocardiographic sequences are temporally standardized by sampling a clip over an estimated cardiac cycle before being processed by the EchoPrime foundation model, which is fine-tuned end-to-end within the proposed architecture. translated_title: 基于注意力多视角融合的基础模型微调用于多任务心脏功能评估
translated_abstract: 在心脏肿瘤学中，左心室射血分数（LVEF）是癌症治疗期间监测心脏功能的标准生物标志物。然而，其通过超声心动图的估算高度依赖于操作者，且具有临床意义的功能下降往往在心肌损伤已经进展后才被发现，这促使人们需要自动化的方法来实现标准化评估和左心室功能障碍的早期检测。为满足这一需求，我们提出了一个多任务框架，整合了基于心动周期的时序标准化、多视角时空特征提取，以及LVEF估算与左心室功能障碍分类的联合优化。心尖四腔心和两腔心超声心动图序列首先通过在估计的心动周期内采样片段进行时序标准化，随后由EchoPrime基础模型处理，该模型在所提出的架构中进行端到端微调。视角特定的特征通过……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个多任务心脏功能评估框架，通过对EchoPrime基础模型进行端到端微调，结合基于心动周期的时序标准化与基于注意力的多视角特征融合，实现LVEF估算与左心室功能障碍分类的联合优化，从而支持心脏肿瘤学中标准化的心脏功能评估与左心室功能障碍的早期检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-task framework that fine-tunes the EchoPrime foundation model end-to-end, integrating cardiac cycle-based temporal standardization and attention-based multi-view fusion for joint LVEF estimation and LV dysfunction classification, enabling standardized and earlier detection of cardiac dysfunction in cardio-oncology.
